name: Special City Council & SDWD Meeting (Goals Workshop) February 2 & 3 8:30 a.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council & SDWD Meeting (Goals Workshop) February 2 & 3 8:30 a.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 4, 2026 -
01:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
City Council: Mayor Ehlers, Deputy Mayor O'Hara, and Council Members Lyndes, San Antonio, and Shaffer
SDWD: President O'Hara, Vice President Ehlers, and Board Members Lyndes, San Antonio, and Shaffer
2.
INTRODUCTIONS
3.
MEETING GROUND RULES AND OBJECTIVES FOR THE WORKSHOP
4.
PUBLIC COMMENTS (ONLY TAKEN ON FEBRUARY 2) - A maximum of 2 hours will be set aside at the beginning of the February 2, 2026, meeting. Speakers remaining after that time will be heard during the lunch break and, if necessary, at the end of the meeting on February 2, 2026. Each speaker is allowed up to three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Please be aware that the Mayor has the authority to reduce equally each speaker's time to accommodate a larger number of speakers.
5.
AGENDA ITEM Please note this is not a budget/CIP workshop. The budget/CIP workshops are tentatively scheduled for City Council meetings on March 18, 2026, and April 8, 2026.
5A.
Fiscal Year 2026-27 City Council Goals Setting Workshop. Contact Person: City Manager Campbell
Mayor, City Council and staff to discuss organizational strategies, objectives, focus areas, goals and desired outcomes for the future.
FY20252026 City Council Work Plan FINAL
FY2025-2026 City Council Work Plan Q2 FINAL
Current Annual Workplan - Vision, Mission, and Focus Statements
2026-02-02 & 03 Special City and SDWD City Counciil Goals Setting Workshop - Public Comments
2026-02-02 & 03 Secial City and SDWD Workshop - Oral Comment
6.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
